edition.title: English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
edition.description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

rows.translation: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh[1],
rows.footnotes: [1] Allah had given Quraysh the honor of being guardians of the Holy Ka‘bah, which allowed them to travel in peace without fear of being harmed.

rows.translation: secure in their winter and summer journeys[2].
rows.footnotes: [2] i.e., their trading caravans would travel south to Yemen in winter and north to the Levant in summer.

rows.translation: Let them worship the Lord of this [Sacred] House[3],
Who fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear[4].
rows.footnotes: [4] The people of Quraysh were blessed with provision and security probably because of the prayer of Abraham. See 14:35-37
